# Auto-generated figure captions

Numbers come straight from the data; edit the wording, not the numbers.

**11_openloop_traces** - Open-loop speed traces at 6 constant-PWM settings (66–432 RPM). The PWM command is constant (zero jitter) yet the speed ripples: std 10.77 % of speed at 66 RPM and 1.85 % at 432 RPM. Same vertical span in all panels.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0066rpm** - Open-loop speed at 66 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 40 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0154rpm** - Open-loop speed at 154 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 40 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0222rpm** - Open-loop speed at 222 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 40 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0281rpm** - Open-loop speed at 281 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 40 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0332rpm** - Open-loop speed at 332 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 40 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_trace_0430rpm** - Open-loop speed at 430 RPM with constant PWM; every graph in this series spans the same 40 RPM.

**individual/11_openloop_overlay_deviation** - All open-loop speeds with each mean removed so the ripple sizes can be compared directly.

**12_openloop_scaling** - Open-loop speed ripple versus speed (18 runs, 66–432 RPM). (a) Amplitude of the 1×, 2× and 12× shaft-order components; (b) total ripple as a percentage of speed. The 2× component follows a log–log slope of −0.76 ± 0.16 (R² = 0.59); a speed−independent torque ripple on a fixed inertia predicts −1, an encoder geometry error +1. The 1× component has slope 0.05 ± 0.29 (R² = 0.00) and shows no clear trend with speed.

**individual/12a_scaling_amplitude** - Open-loop speed ripple versus speed (18 runs, 66–432 RPM). (a) Amplitude of the 1×, 2× and 12× shaft-order components; (b) total ripple as a percentage of speed. The 2× component follows a log–log slope of −0.76 ± 0.16 (R² = 0.59); a speed−independent torque ripple on a fixed inertia predicts −1, an encoder geometry error +1. The 1× component has slope 0.05 ± 0.29 (R² = 0.00) and shows no clear trend with speed.

**individual/12b_ripple_percent** - Total open-loop speed ripple relative to speed: 10.8 % at 66 RPM down to 1.85 % at 432 RPM.

**13_openloop_orders** - Amplitude spectra of the open-loop speed signal with frequency normalised to the shaft rotation frequency. Peaks at integer orders show the ripple is tied to rotation. Components above 50 Hz (100 Hz sampling) alias into the band.

**individual/13_openloop_orders** - Amplitude spectra of the open-loop speed signal with frequency normalised to the shaft rotation frequency. Peaks at integer orders show the ripple is tied to rotation. Components above 50 Hz (100 Hz sampling) alias into the band.

**individual/11a_ol_power_vs_time** - Electrical power (W) after switching the PWM on, one line per duty.

**individual/11a_ol_power_vs_duty** - Steady-state electrical power (w) against the commanded duty, one point per run.

**individual/11a_ol_power_vs_rpm** - Steady-state electrical power (w) against the steady-state speed, one point per run.

**individual/11b_ol_current_vs_time** - Supply current (mA) after switching the PWM on, one line per duty.

**individual/11b_ol_current_vs_duty** - Steady-state supply current (ma) against the commanded duty, one point per run.

**individual/11b_ol_current_vs_rpm** - Steady-state supply current (ma) against the steady-state speed, one point per run.

**individual/11c_ol_voltage_vs_time** - Supply voltage (V) after switching the PWM on, one line per duty.

**individual/11c_ol_voltage_vs_duty** - Steady-state supply voltage (v) against the commanded duty, one point per run.
